messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Alert: customer 'Havencrest' VPC canary failing increased error rate -> 50% 5xx on model-infer workers (dedicated pool: hc-prod-1). auto-escalate to oncall.
jen: acked — I'm oncall. Paging @ryan for infra & @liz for ops/customer comms. Any recent deploys?
deploybot: deploy hc-model/v2.3.8 -> artifact sha256: b1f3c9a6 (canary 10%) started at 3344999000. No exact failures predicted.
jen: looking at traces — tail of ingress shows repeated 503/GATEWAY_TIMEOUT at upstream inference, also spikes in realloc for cuda contexts. snippet: ```2026-03-15T12:04:23Z infer-09 pod/worker-7 OOMKilled
2026-03-15T12:04:24Z infer-09 503 GET /v1/generate```.`
ryan: I'm pulling instance metrics. GPU mem pressure at 95% on hc-pool nodes that received canary. Suspect quantized kernel regression in v2.3.8 on A100-80GB profiled.
liz: @sam can you open a quick line to Havencrest support lead (account: HC_Jess) and say we're investigating and may need short rollback? keep them informed.
sam: on it — pinged HC_Jess via email + slack DM. She asked for ETA and whether this affects dedicated traffic isolation.
jen: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause canary traffic 2) pin traffic back to previous artifact v2.3.7 (sha: 7c9d2a1f) 3) evict affected tenants to reserved fallback pool. I'll pause canary now.
deploybot: action: pause-canary hc-model/v2.3.8 on hc-prod-1 -> result: canary paused (10% -> 0%) at 3345001120.
ryan: recommend pinback to v2.3.7, but we need a controlled staged rollback to avoid cold start spike. Proposed command: ```rbctl release pin --customer havencrest --pool hc-prod-1 --artifact 7c9d2a1f --stagger 30s --batch 10%```
jen: executing pinback now (manual override).
jen: running: ```rbctl release pin --customer havencrest --pool hc-prod-1 --artifact 7c9d2a1f --stagger 20s --batch 25%```
deploybot: rollback initiated: pinned artifact -> 7c9d2a1f. Canary artifact rolled back on 25% batch at 3345002005.
k8s-sentry: tail logs from worker pods during rollback: ```infer-02: startup ok
infer-05: restored kv-cache hit rate 78%
infer-09: previous OOM absent after pinback```
liz: notifying customer: posted to HC_Jess: "We've paused the canary and pinned your pool to previous artifact v2.3.7. We're monitoring; will update in 15 mins."
sam: HC_Jess replied: "Thank you. Please confirm if any inference requests were served incorrectly or lost."
jen: partial impact: up to 1200 requests in canary window (10%) returned 5xx or retried. No data exfiltration; requests retried/backfilled. We'll compile a short incident summary.
ryan: I'll scale up ephemeral ingress nodes by +2 to absorb traffic while we stabilize and run smoke tests against 7c9d2a1f.
ryan: smoke test results: latency stable, error rate down to 0.8% on pinned pool after 4m.
jen: handoff: I'm going offline for on-call shift change in 30m. @ryan & @liz take point for monitoring and customer comms. I'll remain reachable for escalations.
liz: confirmed takeover. I'll open a follow-up incident ticket with timeline + artifacts and ensure HC_Jess gets a postmortem within 24h.
deploybot: artifact pinback complete across hc-prod-1 at 3345003720.
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (not resolved). Postmortem requested; severity P1 -> reduced to P2 for follow-up.
jen: thanks team — create runbook note: add kernel-regression test for quantized paths on A100-80GB in preflight.
ryan: ack. Will add a temporary autoscale rule for hc-prod-1 to reduce blast radius until v2.3.8 is fixed.
sam: Havencrest acknowledged the update and requested timeline for permanent rollback/patch. I'll coordinate with product for patch ETA and keep them posted.
liz: closing thread here; monitoring channel open. cc @incident-bot for postmortem creation.
